# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux fonts and Tizen builds**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 restores Linux system-font discovery and updates Tizen native builds for GCC 14.2. Linux NoDependencies deployments can once again resolve installed system fonts, while Tizen packages are built with the toolchain required by Tizen 10.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — Linux NoDependencies deployments can again locate installed system fonts through the system font manager. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 builds use GCC 14.2** — Tizen native builds and packages now use the compiler toolchain required for Tizen 10. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
